# Tom's GPIO video static driver

`gpiovideodriver_static_0xb8000.lib` is copied byte-for-byte from
`tetris/gpiovideodriver_static_0xb8000.lib` in Tom Morton’s
`ez80-framebuffer-agon` repository at commit
`882ef1a04ea923d354a14f9cafb74bc82c46eeb9`.

Upstream: <https://codeberg.org/tomm8086/ez80-framebuffer-agon>

The upstream README identifies the GPIO video driver as MIT licensed and
documents this static library as the stock-MOS integration path. The local
build verifies its SHA-256 as
`a4234409ca9fd9479c3e2be7c717824e6196dc033ec3073149ebc72a6486a946`.
